priorityList: Use Spear Hand Strike to interrupt target casting.
Invoke Xuen the White Tiger as your primary cooldown, ideally paired with Zenith or Trinkets.
Cast Zenith while Xuen the White Tiger is active or during Bloodlust to trigger Flurry Strikes.
Use Zenith when Rising Sun Kick is on cooldown and you are about to cap on charges or energy.
Cast Celestial Conduit if Zenith is active and your primary strikes (RSK, FoF, SotW) are on cooldown.
Use Whirling Dragon Punch whenever available (requires Rising Sun Kick and Fists of Fury to be on cooldown).
Cast Strike of the Windlord on cooldown, ideally while Zenith or Xuen are active.
Use Fists of Fury on cooldown, especially if you have reached 30 stacks of Flurry Charge.
Cast Rushing Wind Kick on cooldown.
Cast Rising Sun Kick on cooldown, ensuring you do not break your Mastery: Combo Strikes.
Cast Spinning Crane Kick only when the Dance of Chi-Ji proc is active.
Use Touch of Death on targets below the health threshold or when Zenith is not active.
Cast Blackout Kick to consume Combo Breaker procs or as a filler to spend Chi and reduce cooldowns.
Use Tiger Palm to generate Chi when below 4-5 Chi, ensuring you do not use it twice in a row.
Use offensive Trinkets and Racials during Invoke Xuen the White Tiger or when Zenith has high remaining duration.
